algorithm.method: Forward records one bit for each tile/Gaussian pair with at least one valid fragment. Backward stages only set bits and visits them from highest to lowest index, preserving the original pixel grouping, compositing order and half2 reductions.
algorithm.initialized_prefix: (backward_work[tile] + 31) // 32 words; mask the last word at the maximum per-pixel last index
algorithm.inference: Pure RGB rendering compiles record_contributions=False, allocates one unused uint32 output, and omits all contribution ballots/stores; custom VJP forward and training record bits.
algorithm.thresholds: Existing alpha >= 1/256 and T > 1/8192; no new cutoff or gradient-based criterion

fixed_input.origin: Fresh baseline 30k-default bicycle training, images_4, eval=true, seed=0

whole_step.protocol: same fresh 1M-capacity checkpoint, view 0, SH3, Optax, 8x16 tiles, 8M pair arena, 30 warmup and 500 timed NNX updates with donation; three alternating rounds; other GPU compute processes monitored every 0.5 seconds

full_training.protocol: images_4, eval=true, 30k default configuration, seed=0, 169 training views, 25 held-out views, 29913 updates, 8x16 tiles, 1M capacity, 8M pair arena, Optax, three alternating rounds; other GPU processes checked every 0.5 seconds; all six models evaluated with original 8x16 renderer; first candidate development run replaced unconditionally with final production source (including inference bypass), yielding three final-source training trials
